author: Liggy
body: Hey, my name is now Iiggy, but I played on Avicus with the account Liggy1000. I was permanently banned a while ago for /report-ing someone. My report was, I admit, not a professional report. I did /report Baseballshane gay ; as a joke. Without warning, immediately after the report I was banned permanently. My report is a poor reflection on what I am in real life. I hope that I can begin to play on this server once again. I will make sure to be mindful of the stuff I write in chat, and the impact that it could have. Thank you for reading and I hope to play here again.
